title: "Resource ID Feature"
format: html

## Feature engineering

```{r}
library(duckdb)
library(tidyverse)
library(duckplyr)
con <- dbConnect(duckdb())
tbl_pointer <- tbl(con, "read_parquet('CAISO_dam_big.parquet')")
data <- tbl_pointer |>
  filter(
    MARKETPRODUCTTYPE == "EN",
    RESOURCE_TYPE == "GENERATOR",
    !is.na(RESOURCEBID_SEQ)
  ) |>
  select(
    RESOURCEBID_SEQ,
    STARTTIME,
    SCH_BID_XAXISDATA,
    SCH_BID_Y1AXISDATA,
    SELFSCHEDMW
  ) |>
  collect()
```

Get max MW

```{r}
safe_max <- \(...) {
  x <- c(...)
  if (all(is.na(x))) NA_real_ else max(x, na.rm = TRUE)
}

observed_max <- data |>
  summarize(
    max_mw = safe_max(SCH_BID_XAXISDATA, SELFSCHEDMW),
    .by = RESOURCEBID_SEQ
  )
```

Mean and median number of knots
```{r}
knots <- data |>
  summarise(knots = n(), .by = c(STARTTIME, RESOURCEBID_SEQ)) |>
  summarise(mean = mean(knots), median = median(knots), .by = RESOURCEBID_SEQ)
```

single-point frequency

```{r}
single <- data |>
  group_by(STARTTIME, RESOURCEBID_SEQ) |>
  mutate(knots = n(), single_bid_hour = knots == 1) |>
  ungroup() |>
  group_by(RESOURCEBID_SEQ) |>
  summarise(
    total_bids = n(),
    num_single = sum(single_bid_hour),
    pct_single = 100 * num_single / total_bids
  ) |>
  select(RESOURCEBID_SEQ, pct_single)
```

% of all bids that are NULL bids

```{r}
null <- data |>
  filter(is.na(SELFSCHEDMW)) |>
  group_by(RESOURCEBID_SEQ) |>
  summarise(
    has_null = any((is.na(SCH_BID_XAXISDATA)) & (is.na(SCH_BID_Y1AXISDATA)))
  )
```

% of self scheduled bids

```{r}
self <- data |>
  mutate(self_sched = !is.na(SELFSCHEDMW)) |>
  group_by(RESOURCEBID_SEQ) |>
  summarise(pct_self_sched = 100 * mean(self_sched))
```

hours_tbl

```{r}
hours_tbl <- data |>
  mutate(hour = hour(ymd_hms(STARTTIME))) |>
  select(RESOURCEBID_SEQ, hour) |>
  group_by(RESOURCEBID_SEQ, hour) |>
  summarise(num_bids = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(RESOURCEBID_SEQ) |>
  mutate(pct_per_hour = 100 * num_bids / sum(num_bids)) |>
  select(!num_bids) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = hour,
    values_from = pct_per_hour,
    names_prefix = "hour_",
    values_fill = 0
  )
```

negative bids

```{r}
negatives <- data |>
  summarize(
    has_negative = any(SCH_BID_XAXISDATA < 0, SELFSCHEDMW < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    .by = RESOURCEBID_SEQ
  )
```

dates of start and end

```{r}
start_end <- data |>
  select(RESOURCEBID_SEQ, STARTTIME) |>
  mutate(STARTTIME = as.Date(STARTTIME)) |>
  group_by(RESOURCEBID_SEQ) |>
  summarise(start = min(STARTTIME), end = max(STARTTIME), .groups = "drop")
```

join everything

```{r}
features <- knots |>
  left_join(single, by = join_by(RESOURCEBID_SEQ == RESOURCEBID_SEQ)) |>
  left_join(null, by = join_by(RESOURCEBID_SEQ == RESOURCEBID_SEQ)) |>
  left_join(negatives, by = join_by(RESOURCEBID_SEQ == RESOURCEBID_SEQ)) |>
  left_join(self, by = join_by(RESOURCEBID_SEQ == RESOURCEBID_SEQ)) |>
  left_join(hours_tbl, by = join_by(RESOURCEBID_SEQ == RESOURCEBID_SEQ)) |>
  left_join(start_end, by = join_by(RESOURCEBID_SEQ == RESOURCEBID_SEQ)) |>
  left_join(observed_max, by = join_by(RESOURCEBID_SEQ == RESOURCEBID_SEQ)) |>
  replace_na(list(has_null = TRUE)) |>
  arrow::write_parquet(here::here("ID_attributes.parquet"))
```

## Feature matching

```{r}
features <- arrow::read_parquet(here::here("ID_attributes.parquet"))

prepare_scaled_features <- function(
  features_df,
  center = TRUE,
  scale = TRUE,
  weights = NULL
) {
  scaled <- features_df |>
    mutate(days_active = as.numeric(end - start)) |>
    select(-RESOURCEBID_SEQ, -start, -end) |>
    as.matrix() |>
    scale(center = center, scale = scale)

  scaled[is.nan(scaled)] <- 0

  if (!is.null(weights)) {
    weights <- weights[colnames(scaled)]

    if (anyNA(weights)) {
      stop("weights must be named and include every feature column")
    }

    scaled <- sweep(scaled, 2, sqrt(weights), `*`)
  }

  scaled
}

set_matrix_ids <- function(mat, features_df) {
  ids <- features_df$RESOURCEBID_SEQ
  rownames(mat) <- ids
  colnames(mat) <- ids
  mat
}

compute_cosine <- function(features_df, weights = NULL) {
  scaled <- prepare_scaled_features(features_df)

  row_norms <- sqrt(rowSums(scaled^2))
  row_norms[row_norms == 0] <- 1

  normed <- scaled / row_norms

  sim_mat <- tcrossprod(normed)

  set_matrix_ids(sim_mat, features_df)
}

compute_euclidean <- function(features_df, weights = NULL) {
  features_df |>
    prepare_scaled_features(scale = FALSE, weights = weights) |>
    dist(method = "euclidean") |>
    as.matrix() |>
    set_matrix_ids(features_df)
}
```

```{r}
cos_sim <- compute_cosine(features)
cos_sim["144033", "177696"]

euc_dist <- compute_euclidean(features)
euc_dist["144033", "177696"]
```

```{r}
# Find the most similar generators to a given resource ID.
# start_filter: NULL (no filter), "after" (candidates started after id), "before" (candidates started before id)
find_similar <- function(
  id,
  sim_matrix,
  features_df,
  rank_by = c("smallest", "largest"),
  start_filter = c("none", "after", "before")
) {
  rank_by <- match.arg(rank_by)
  start_filter <- match.arg(start_filter)
  id <- as.character(id)

  if (!id %in% rownames(sim_matrix)) {
    stop("id not found in sim_matrix")
  }

  scores <- sim_matrix[id, ]
  scores <- scores[names(scores) != id]

  if (start_filter != "none") {
    starts <- features_df |>
      mutate(
        RESOURCEBID_SEQ = as.character(RESOURCEBID_SEQ),
        start,
        .keep = "none"
      )

    id_start <- starts$start[starts$RESOURCEBID_SEQ == id]

    if (length(id_start) != 1) {
      stop("id must match exactly one row in features_df")
    }

    candidate_starts <- starts$start[
      match(names(scores), starts$RESOURCEBID_SEQ)
    ]

    keep <- switch(
      start_filter,
      after = candidate_starts > id_start,
      before = candidate_starts < id_start
    )

    scores <- scores[keep]
  }

  sort(
    scores,
    decreasing = rank_by == "largest"
  ) |>
    enframe(name = "ID", value = "Distance")
}
```

```{r}
cos_sim <- compute_cosine(features)
euc_dist <- compute_euclidean(features)

find_similar("144033", euc_dist, features, start_filter = "after") |>
  slice_head(n = 7)
```

## Weighted

```{r}
hour_cols <- grep("^hour_", colnames(features), value = TRUE)

feature_weights <- c(
  mean = 3,
  median = 2,
  pct_single = 4,
  has_null = 4,
  pct_self_sched = 4,
  has_negative = 1,
  max_mw = 1,
  days_active = Inf, # zero out number of active days
  setNames(rep(2 * length(hour_cols), length(hour_cols)), hour_cols)
) |>
  (\(ranks) 1 / ranks)() |>
  prop.table()

cos_sim <- compute_cosine(features, weights = feature_weights)
euc_dist <- compute_euclidean(features, weights = feature_weights)

find_similar("144033", euc_dist, features, start_filter = "after") |>
  slice_head(n = 7)
```
